titulo: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon with ~4 KB of RAM 🚀
descripcion: The Apollo Guidance Computer had 2,048 words of erasable memory and programs woven by hand into core rope.

escenas.texto: The computer that landed Apollo eleven on the Moon had about four kilobytes of working memory.
Two thousand forty eight words, sixteen bits each.
Its clock ran at about one megahertz.
Many phones today have eight gigabytes of memory. That's about two million times more.
Its programs were stored in core rope memory, woven by hand, wire by wire.
It had less memory than one photo on your phone. Follow for more tech secrets.
